caveats: Population: pretrained model, own test set, 2024 only (DOY 122-366) - predictions/pretrained_stec/own holds a fixed random subset of the test split (10,000,000 observations spanning 2014-2024, all 242 days of 2024 among them - see stec.analysis.pretrained_test_diagnostics's docstring), not the full test set the daily fine-tuned model is scored against.
Limited by n = 58 test stations (this stage's own per_station.csv row count), not by observation count. Adding days sharpens each point but does not sharpen the Spearman coefficient.
Strengthening this result needs a region-held-out retrain, not more data.
description: test-station error against distance to the nearest training station, for the pretrained model on the same 2024 population as station_independence
